title: MW Missions
content: This has just been my experience. I’ve been having MW dreams consistently for about two years now. The first one started with me arriving on an airplane and landing on an airport strip that was directly on the ocean. Now from what I’ve noticed, each dream seems to involve a different mission or objective, getting through certain parts of MW, navigating obstacles(the waterpark, the gross toilets, etc) or sometimes trying to save my daughter from apocalyptic scenarios. On two occasions, I felt like I actually completed the mission, and both times the dream shifted afterward into something really beautiful and ethereal. These are just my personal observations, but I’m curious if anyone else experienced something similar.
